Definition: from G3844 and G1165; to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy:--make a public example, put to an open shame.
BiblicalUsage: Paradeigmatizō occurs once: those who fall away crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh and put Him to an open shame.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one verse is the Bible's sternest warning about turning back: to fall away after tasting the truth is to shame Christ openly before the world.
